.busca-site-toggle-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 16px 0 24px 0;
  vertical-align: top;
}
.busca-site-toggle-wrap p {
  margin: 0;
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: top;
}
.busca-site-toggle-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  height: 42px;
  background: #f7f7f7;
  border: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #333;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all .2s ease;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.busca-site-toggle-btn:hover,
.busca-site-toggle-btn:focus {
  background: #efefef;
  border-color: #c8c8c8;
  outline: 2px solid #005fcc;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.busca-site-icone {
  line-height: 1;
}
.busca-site-seta {
  font-size: 11px;
  transition: transform .2s ease;
}
.busca-site-toggle-wrap.aberta .busca-site-seta {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}
/* Caixa da busca ao lado direito, sem empurrar conteúdo */
.busca-site-google-box {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: calc(100% + 12px);
  width: 620px;
  height: 42px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  border: 1px solid #d8d8d8 !important;
  background: #fff !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  z-index: 50;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.busca-site-toggle-wrap.aberta .busca-site-google-box {
  display: flex;
}
/* Campo Google */
.busca-site-google-campo {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
}
/* Não criar lupa artificial */
.busca-site-google-campo::before {
  display: none !important;
  content: none !important;
}
/* =========================================================
   Google CSE - estrutura base
   ========================================================= */
.busca-site-google-campo .gcse-search,
.busca-site-google-campo .gsc-control-cse,
.busca-site-google-campo .gsc-control-wrapper-cse {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 40px !important;
}
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-control-cse,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-control-cse-en {
  border: 0 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}
/* Esconde branding externo do Google, se ele aparecer fora do input */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-branding,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gcsc-branding {
  display: none !important;
}
/* Remove bordas herdadas do tema */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-control-cse table td,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-control-cse table th,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-control-cse-en table td,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-control-cse-en table th {
  border: 0 !important;
}
/* Form principal */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap form.gsc-search-box,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap table.gsc-search-box {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 40px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}
/* Tabela interna do input */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap table.gsc-input {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 40px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  table-layout: fixed !important;
}
.busca-site-toggle-wrap table.gsc-input tbody,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap table.gsc-input tr {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 40px !important;
}
/* Célula principal do campo */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap table.gsc-input td.gsib_a,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsib_a {
  width: 100% !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  vertical-align: middle !important;
}
/* Esconde o X e áreas laterais */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap table.gsc-input td.gsib_b,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsib_b,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsst_b,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsst_a,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gscb_a {
  display: none !important;
  width: 0 !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  max-width: 0 !important;
  height: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
/* Caixa interna */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-input-box,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-input-box-hover,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-input-box-focus {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 40px !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  background-color: #fff !important;
}
/* Campo de texto.
   Mantém o visual nativo do Google dentro do campo.
   O texto digitado fica afastado da lupa. */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap input.gsc-input {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 38px !important;
  line-height: 38px !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 12px 0 16px !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: #333 !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  text-indent: 0 !important;
}
/* Remove botão azul/lupa do Google */
.busca-site-toggle-wrap td.gsc-search-button,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-search-button,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-search-button-v2,
.busca-site-toggle-wrap .gsc-search-button-v2 svg {
  display: none !important;
  width: 0 !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  max-width: 0 !important;
  height: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
/* Resultado overlay do Google */
.gsc-results-wrapper-overlay {
  top: 255px !important;
  background: #fff !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}
/* Caption acessível */
.busca-site-caption-visually-hidden {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px !important;
  height: 1px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: -1px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}
/* =========================================================
   Mobile
   ========================================================= */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .busca-site-toggle-wrap {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .busca-site-toggle-wrap p {
    display: block;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .busca-site-toggle-btn {
    font-size: 13px;
    height: 40px;
    padding: 0 10px;
  }
  .busca-site-google-box {
    position: static;
    width: 100%;
    height: 46px;
    min-height: 46px;
    margin-top: 10px;
    display: none;
